objective.name: J1
objective.description: J1 = effort per character, lower is better: key effort + Shift + bigram penalties (Colemak Mod-DH model, ANSI, model-optimal fingering), averaged 1/2 x bnwiki/train + 1/2 x newspaper/train. Same objective as the Bangla-DH mixed search of 10 October 2026.

D.description: context (sign after a consonant, else independent; same key again = independent; a run after a consonant pairs from the end, 3 = sign + independent)

public_layouts.metric: average held-out J1 (Wikipedia, newspaper, unseen news); lower is better
public_layouts.note: Only fixed layouts are compared (phonetic layouts such as Avro Phonetic are not). Market layouts are the fixed layouts installed in Kala when the research ran.
